name: smwgraphics-knights-of-the-round-the-expedition-1st-loop
title: Knights of the Round - The Expedition (1st Loop)
description:
Background of the first loop in The Expedition level in Knights of the Round (SNES).

Note that this background slightly cutoffs when looped, so I recomend using it either in short levels or setting H-Scroll to Slow.

Moderator's note: despite what the author mentioned above, the cutoffs are subtle enough and can be worked around with minor graphical and/or Map16 adjustments.
